revenue.label: Revenue (excluding finance income)
revenue.note: Continuing operations. Note 6 (pdf 100): Sales revenue 25,845 (Rendering of services 23,022; Sale of goods 2,426; Construction contracts 397) plus Other revenue 178 (Distribution from Foxtel Partnership 125; Rent from property 53).

other_income.label: Other income
other_income.note: Note 6 (pdf 100): includes net gain on disposal of PP&E and intangibles 156, government grants 138, NBN disconnection fees 163.

cost_of_sales.note: Not presented: by-nature statement. Note 7 (pdf 101) discloses 'Cost of goods sold' 3,079 (OFR pdf 26 says COGS is part of Goods and services purchased: mobile handsets, tablets, dongles, broadband modems).

raw_materials_and_inventory.label: Goods and services purchased
raw_materials_and_inventory.note: By-nature purchases line. Includes cost of goods sold 3,079 (note 7, pdf 101); OFR (pdf 26) also cites network payments 1,725 and other goods and services purchased 2,043.

employee_benefits_expense.label: Labour
employee_benefits_expense.note: Face line. OFR (pdf 26): includes salary and associated costs 3,686, labour substitution costs (contractors/agency) 816 and redundancy 113, so 'Labour' is broader than employee benefits.

depreciation_and_amortisation.label: Depreciation and amortisation
depreciation_and_amortisation.note: Note 7 (pdf 101): depreciation of PP&E 2,922; amortisation of intangible assets 1,061.

impairment.label: Impairment losses
impairment.note: Note 7 subtotal within Other expenses: inventories 23, trade and other receivables 189, PP&E 10, intangibles 5, goodwill -, investments 2. Separate 'Reversal of impairment in value of trade and other receivables' (12) not netted.

selling_general_admin_lines.label: Other expenses
selling_general_admin_lines.note: face line, by-nature residual; not a by-function SG&A

ebit.label: Earnings before interest and income tax expense (EBIT)
ebit.note: Printed, continuing operations. EBITDA 10,745 also printed.

finance_costs.label: Finance costs
finance_costs.note: Finance income 157 shown separately; Net finance costs 689.

profit_before_tax.label: Profit before income tax expense
profit_before_tax.note: Continuing operations. Discontinued operation PBT 19 (note 5, pdf 99).

net_profit_after_tax.label: Equity holders of Telstra Entity
net_profit_after_tax.note: Attributable to members 4,231. Total 'Profit for the year from continuing and discontinued operations' 4,305 (continuing 4,286 + discontinued 19); non-controlling interests 74.

ppe_net.label: Property, plant and equipment
ppe_net.note: Non current assets, Statement of Financial Position (printed page 73).

employees.label: full time staff and equivalents (FTE)
employees.note: FTE, total Telstra Group, stated in Full Year Results and Operations Review text (printed page 24): 'Our total full time staff and equivalents (FTE) increased to 36,165.'

australian_revenue_share.label: Australian customers (Revenue from external customers)
australian_revenue_share.note: Note 5 geographic: Australian customers 24,770; Offshore customers 1,253; total 26,023. Share not computed here.
